content: Cahwa galagala
Sahena tomota waꞌahwaꞌahwa galagaladi ꞌamuge wete Yehoba ꞌiꞌahwa galagalaegomi.
Weyahina to ginaula ꞌoidiyega tomota waꞌahwa galagalaedi nata ꞌoidiyega Yehoba ꞌiꞌahwa galagalaegomi, ma wete togidega wamumuga ꞌesa tomota ꞌoidiya Yehoba gide wete ꞌimumuga ꞌoimiya.
Ma geya sawasawahina ma tasiu weyahina ꞌugwae ꞌabehega matana ꞌaiwe tupwatupwana ꞌimiyamiya, weyahina ꞌowa wete matauwa ꞌetupwa ꞌimiyamiya, ma geya ꞌuꞌita.
Geyaꞌabwa tasiu ꞌugwaegwaene ꞌabehega ꞌaiwe tupwatupwana ꞌuꞌewayahule matanega, weyahina ꞌowa wete matauwa ꞌetupwa ꞌimiyamiya.
Cowa hede ꞌaigeda toꞌabo, ꞌawa? Ma hesi ꞌetupwa matauwega ꞌuꞌewayahule nugete, ma ꞌoinega ꞌuꞌebubuna bwaibwaina ma muliyetega tasiu matanega ꞌaiwe tupwatupwana ꞌuꞌewayahule.
Sahena Yehoba ꞌina ginaulao ꞌuꞌeꞌeheleye ꞌedewa ꞌoidiya, tabu ta silogwahatedi ma sinaligo. Geya sawasawahina ma wete ꞌimi bagi bawe waꞌebwaꞌebwaedi, tabu ma wete siꞌahuhe biꞌibiꞌidi.
Cahwanoi weyahina
Waꞌahwanoi, ma Yehoba ꞌiꞌebwaegomi. Wete waꞌebesa ma ꞌoinega waloba. Ma waulaꞌeꞌe ma ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌisoꞌe.
Ceguma taꞌahwanoi, Yehoba ꞌiꞌebwaya ꞌoida, ma ꞌeguma taꞌebeꞌebesa ꞌabwa taloba, ma wete ꞌeguma taꞌeulaulaꞌeꞌe beno ꞌahwaꞌeda ꞌihuwe ꞌoida.
Ma togidega ꞌomi gwagwama tamadiyao, ꞌeguma natumiyao ꞌeꞌahai weyahina siꞌahwanoi, beno daꞌule waꞌebwaedi?
Bo ꞌeguma silahana weyahina siꞌahwanoi mwata waꞌebwaedi? Geya hene!

Moisa ꞌomi togala, ma ꞌimi ꞌehele natumiyao ꞌoidiya wasanapu pwaiya, ꞌabehega ginaula ꞌausaladimo waꞌebwaꞌebwaedi. Gide wete Tamamiu galewa, ꞌeguma waꞌahwanoi ꞌoina, ꞌisanapuya toꞌaha bwebweꞌana ꞌilobwainegomiya ma ꞌiꞌebwaegomi.
Ma ꞌeguma nuwanuwami toꞌaha ma tomota ꞌoimiya sipaihowa, beno ꞌomi wete gide ꞌoidiya wapaihowa ꞌese, weyahina bewa Mosese ma palopitao ꞌidi loina ꞌana bwagila.
Cahwa ꞌiꞌiuna
Cahwa ꞌiꞌiuna ꞌoinega waluhu ma sahena ꞌahwa madouna ꞌoinega, beno ꞌebe hesilae ꞌana ꞌeda. Cedaina madouna ma ꞌana tauya meyameyahana ma tomota mabwaiyadi ꞌoina sitautauya.
Ma yawasi bwebweꞌana ꞌana ꞌeda ꞌana tauya mwauna, ta ꞌana ꞌahwa ꞌiꞌiuna tuwa, ma tomota hisahisadimo ꞌoina siluhuluhu.
Caiwe mahuwaina
Tohepwaila ꞌaboꞌabodi ꞌoidiyega waꞌitayahigomi, weyahina tupwadi ꞌabwa sinaoma ꞌoimiya, ꞌadi ꞌita gide sipi manamanasamidi, ma ꞌalodiya hesi gide tuwa ꞌedewa lolosasa.
Ma ꞌidi paihowao ꞌoidiyega ꞌabwa wasanapudi, weyahina talitali geya sawasawahina huwaina ꞌihepiyoi. Buyubuyuwa wete gide geya sawasawahina ma huwaina ꞌihedamaya.
Weyahina ꞌaiwe bwebweꞌadi huwaidi bwebweꞌadi, ma ꞌaiwe galadi huwaidi wete galadi.
Ma ꞌiyamo ꞌaiwe bwebweꞌadi geya sawasawahina ma huwaidi galadi sihuwaedi. Ta wete ꞌaiwe galadi geya sawasawahidi ma huwaidi bwebweꞌadi sihuwaedi.
Ma hene ꞌeguma ꞌaiwe geya sida huwa huwaina bwebweꞌana, nata tagoha yahule ma tagabu.
Gide wete tohepwaila ꞌaboꞌabodi ꞌidi paihowega sawasawahina taꞌinanadi.
Toꞌabowao
Baibaiwadi ꞌoiguwa siꞌahwaꞌahwa bada ma ꞌabwa sahena siluhuluhu Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina, beno namo taudi Tamagu galewa ꞌana tohematamatanao.

Tuta ꞌinaonaoma ꞌoina tomota baibaiwadi ꞌabwa ꞌoiguwa sigwae, “Bada, ꞌapaihowa weyahiu ma saniuwega ꞌalologuguya ma hiꞌahiꞌa tomota ꞌoidiyega ꞌaula latuwediya, ma wete paihowa ꞌebe henainaida ꞌapaihowediya.”
Ma hesi ꞌoidiya ꞌabwa yagwae, “Geya yasanapugomi taiyawedi ꞌomi. Wahila ma geyaꞌabwa waluhuluhuma, weyahina ꞌomi togala.”
Hada ꞌana wahuwahu
Cigu gwae bewa ꞌeguma taiya ꞌihesagohedi ma ꞌihematamatanedi, tauna gide ꞌaigeda tohadaꞌabi sanasanapuna, ꞌina wahuwahu dimwa ꞌoina ꞌiꞌabiya,
ma muliyetega dohi ꞌidobima, ma yagewa ꞌidauma, wete yaumai madouna ꞌitowa, ma ꞌina hadaina geya ꞌiguli, weyahina ꞌina wahuwahu dimwa ꞌoina ꞌiꞌabiya.
Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌigu gwae bewa ꞌihesagohediya ma geya ꞌimuliyedi, tauna gide toheyauyaule ꞌina hada ꞌiꞌabiya nenegwala ꞌoina.
Coinega dohi madouna ꞌidobiya, ma yagewa ꞌidauwa, ma wete yaumai madouna ꞌitowa, ma hadaina ꞌiguliya ma ꞌileꞌwa yahuleya.
Tutaina heꞌita bewa Yesu ꞌilosalohidiya ma bodaedi nuwadi ꞌihenainaida,
ma sigwae, “Heꞌita bewa waiwaina, ma ꞌida loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ꞌidi heꞌita weꞌana.”
